task_title: PRD milestone exclusion list names the closed row CF-183
task_criteria: At the landed commit, from the repository root: (1) jq -r 'select(.id=="CF-183")|.status' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl prints complete, and docs/PRD-code-factory.md describes CF-183 as closed at 5069c0a on verdict a539f890 rather than listing it as an open exclusion — grep -c 'CLOSED at .5069c0a' docs/PRD-code-factory.md equals 1 and the phrase 'Rows that are open, leg-adjacent and deliberately EXCLUDED' is followed by an 'open rows only' membership rule plus the jq command that decides it; (2) the milestone block's pinned snapshot names the tip it was measured at and its numbers reproduce: rows = wc -l .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl and events = wc -l .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl at that tip match the numbers the block quotes, and the earlier tips 171bf23 (158/308) and bc68e59 (148/273) still reproduce with git show; (3) bash docs/audits/cf099-prd-drift-probe.sh exits 0 and prints 'OK: milestone, plan snapshot and layer arms agree at <tip>'; (4) bash tests/selftest.sh exits 0 and prints SELFTEST: PASS; (5) no requirement was added: git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD shows only docs/PRD-code-factory.md and .coding-hermes/board/. The row CF-186's §7c restoration and CF-182's full resolution script are explicit NON-goals of this commit.
